evidence_claim: formatDelivery clips the whole delivery text to totalMax=10000 after appending messages, so a batch with several long bodies loses later messages, the raw-batch path and the orca_ack instruction; the coordinator cannot process every message and may ack unseen questions or worker_done (corroborated by JD-B-002).

The wrapper kills its watchdog as soon as the foreground shell exits; a bg_run command that backgrounds a child and exits leaves that child alive in the process group, TaskManager marks the task done and shutdown skips it, so the child outlives the session.
bg_tail (and task exit notices in lib/tasks/notice.ts) redact per line, so the multiline PEM pattern never matches and private-key material lines are forwarded unredacted to the model and terminal.
The task log WriteStream has no error listener; a failed open or write emits an unhandled error that terminates the Pi process, interrupting the session and its Orca bridge.
